rules.title: Security Deposit Investment and Interest
rules.requirement: Landlords must invest security deposits in an insured money market fund or a State/federally chartered bank in an interest-bearing account and provide written notice of the account details to the tenant within 30 days of receipt.

coverage.summary: All rental premises or units used for dwelling purposes, except owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units where the tenant has not provided 30 days written notice.
coverage.owner_condition: owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units
coverage.unresolvable: tenant must provide 30 days written notice for owner-occupied premises with <= 2 units

rules.exemptions: Seasonal use or rental for a term of not more than 125 consecutive days for residential purposes by a person having a permanent place of residence elsewhere.
rules.quoted_span: Whenever money or other form of security shall be deposited or advanced on a contract, lease or license agreement for the use or rental of real property as security for performance of the contract, lease or agreement or to be applied to payments upon such contract, lease or agreement when due, such money or other form of security, until repaid or so applied including the tenant's portion of the interest or earnings accumulated thereon as hereinafter provided, shall continue to be the property of the person making such deposit or advance and shall be held in trust by the person with whom such deposit or advance shall be made for the use in accordance with the terms of the contract, lease or agreement and shall not be mingled with the personal property or become an asset of the person receiving the same.

rules.title: Return of Security Deposit
rules.requirement: Landlords must return the security deposit plus interest, minus any lawful deductions, within 30 days after the termination of the lease.

rules.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of the tenant's lease or licensee's agreement, the owner or lessee shall return by personal delivery, registered or certified mail the sum so deposited plus the tenant's portion of the interest or earnings accumulated thereon, less any charges expended in accordance with the terms of a contract, lease, or agreement, to the tenant or licensee

rules.title: Limitation on Amount of Security Deposit
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot require a security deposit exceeding 1.5 times one month's rent. Any annual additional security deposit cannot exceed 10% of the current deposit.
